criteria.title: Workflow routing
criteria.description: Evaluate whether qa-workflow routes the required analysis and design stages and avoids unnecessary E2E implementation or execution, using the fixed task and normalized routing evidence. Rating 1 applies when required major stages are skipped without valid cause and workflow quality is no longer usable.

criteria.title: Workflow completion decision
criteria.description: Evaluate whether the final workflow decision distinguishes completed work from missing, blocked, or unresolved required outcomes. Rating 1 applies when required major artifacts or serious unresolved issues are hidden behind a completion claim.

criteria.title: Oracle selection
criteria.description: Evaluate the precedence of normative specifications over README, implementation observations, and unresolved specifications. Rating 1 applies when an unresolved or lower-authority statement is promoted to a confirmed expected behavior and causes materially wrong tests.

criteria.title: Checkout session lifecycle
criteria.description: Evaluate resume, replacement after cart/version change, 24-hour expiry, and re-login return behavior against BR-CHECKOUT-001, AC-CHECKOUT-001, state-and-scenarios.md, and authentication session/role/return rules. Rating 1 applies when a major lifecycle boundary is wrong or absent so core test conditions fail.

criteria.title: Cart and price revalidation
criteria.description: Evaluate Cart Version and price revalidation immediately before Order confirmation and required rollback/return behavior against BR-CHECKOUT-002, AC-CHECKOUT-002, and cart specifications. Rating 1 applies when stale cart or price mismatch may still create an Order or Payment, or both key boundaries are absent.

criteria.title: Payment, Order, Inventory, and History consistency
criteria.description: Evaluate Mock Payment success and explicit failure against BR-CHECKOUT-003, AC-CHECKOUT-003, orders, and inventory specifications. Rating 1 applies when inventory decreases outside TEST-SUCCESS, successful paid Order and inventory effects are missing, explicit failure changes inventory, or purchase/history consistency is ignored.

criteria.title: Processing and final inventory boundaries
criteria.description: Evaluate resume while processing, retry/cancel prohibition, and final inventory shortage against BR-CHECKOUT-003, AC-CHECKOUT-003, and state-and-scenarios.md. Rating 1 applies when retry/cancel is allowed during processing or an important resume/inventory-shortage boundary is missing.

criteria.title: Executable test design
criteria.description: Evaluate how analysis becomes concrete test requirements, conditions, and cases with preconditions, actions, and observable pass/fail outcomes. Rating 1 applies when multiple important cases cannot be executed because essential inputs, actions, or expected outcomes cannot be identified.

criteria.title: Traceability meaning and closure
criteria.description: Evaluate semantic correspondence from Authority to Test Requirement to Test Condition to Coverage Item to Test Case and treatment of open coverage, using canonical QA artifacts only. Rating 1 applies when important specifications and tests do not correspond, downstream artifacts are grounded in a different requirement, or serious gaps are claimed closed without evidence.

criteria.title: No unsupported expected behavior
criteria.description: Evaluate whether behavior absent from product scope and normative Checkout/Payment specifications is presented as confirmed behavior. Rating 1 applies when unsupported external payment APIs/providers, server-side authorization, backend communication failures, nonexistent Toast behavior, or similar assumptions become confirmed expected results.
